name: cgc-tag-explorer
description: Quartz 5 component: browse a site by tag, in a tree of the cgc-tags engine's tags, each in its tag's colour with its icon, and a drawer of its own on a narrow screen. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//dependencies: @chaoticgoodcomputing/icons draws each tag's icon while the site builds, with Iconify's packages, which can't all be inlined (svgo, under @iconify/tools, reads its data files at run time). So they stay out of dist/ and install here, at exactly the library's versions, which build.mjs checks (libs/icons/docs/adr/0001). MDI is one of them, pinned exactly, and by the workspace's lock: nothing is fetched.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/ and the browser script, inlining our libraries, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships (build.mjs). The libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-tag-explorer
quartz.description: Browse the site by tag: a tree of the cgc-tags engine's tags, each in its tag's colour with its icon, the pages under each, and a drawer of its own on a narrow screen.
